title: Tsukimichi export
description: The JSON files Tsukimichi writes from Settings › Data › Export and /tsuki export (docs/export-format.md). formatVersion is bumped only when a field changes meaning or goes away; new fields may be added at any time, so the objects allow properties this schema does not name.

gameVersion.description: The game client's version; empty when it could not be read

character.description: Present only when Include character name is ticked

completionDatesSinceUtc.description: Quests: when completion dates started being recorded

unknownCount.description: Moonlit: rows whose obtained state is unknown

questId.description: The runtime quest id (rowId's low 16 bits)

name.description: The quest name in the client's language

completedAt.description: When Tsukimichi first saw the quest completed; absent when not known

completedAfter.description: For a quest found completed at a login: the capture before it

state.description: Added in 1.8.0. The character's state of the quest (as Tsukimichi.GetState names it); absent when the character was not evaluated. A later version may add a state: read one you do not know as Unknown

displayLevel.description: Added in 1.8.0. The level the journal and the Lodestone print

patch.description: Added in 1.8.0. The patch the quest was added in ("2.0", "6.55"); absent when unknown

isMsq.description: Added in 1.8.0. A main scenario quest

repeatable.description: Added in 1.8.0. A daily, weekly or other repeatable quest

lodestoneId.description: Added in 1.8.0. The Lodestone Eorzea Database id: https://na.finalfantasyxiv.com/lodestone/playguide/db/quest/<lodestoneId>/; absent when unknown

kind.description: Reward kind: Emote, Mount, Minion, Orchestrion, TripleTriadCard, Barding, Hairstyle, Ornament, DutyUnlock, SystemUnlock, Action, Title, Item, …

rewardId.description: Row id in the sheet the kind refers to

availability.description: Added in 1.5.0. Whether the reward can still be had through this quest

itemId.description: Added in 1.8.0. The item that teaches or holds the reward; absent for a reward without one

collectId.description: Added in 1.8.0. The reward's FFXIV Collect id (https://ffxivcollect.com/<kind path>/<collectId>); absent when unknown
